product_one_liner.value: Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform for DevOps and platform engineering teams that helps them provision, govern, and automate infrastructure-as-code workflows across tools and cloud environments.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as an infrastructure orchestration platform and identifies DevOps and platform engineering teams as its audience.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing plans, including a free plan and a Starter plan with a starting price.

named_customers.notes: These names appear on Spacelift's customer success stories page.

employee_band.notes: The careers page describes the company as having 130+ employees and elsewhere lists 140 team members, both within this band.

hq_location.notes: The company identifies Redwood City, California, USA as its headquarters and lists a Redwood City company address.

founded_year.notes: Spacelift's careers page says it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering blog category includes multiple technical articles, including posts on worker-pool architecture, AWS Lambda migration, PostgreSQL query plans, and Kubernetes-based CI/CD workers.

public_docs.notes: Spacelift has a public documentation site with extensive product and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists current openings, but none of the listed job titles is an AI, ML, machine-learning, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: Spacelift's managed default AI integration uses Anthropic Claude models through AWS Bedrock. Documentation also lists Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock as supported providers for integrations.
model_provider.notes: The documentation distinguishes Spacelift-managed model access from bring-your-own-model integrations.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. It also mentions FedRAMP authorization, which is not one of the certification categories requested.

last_funding.notes: Spacelift announced its $51 million Series C on July 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2025 Series C falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings include an Enterprise Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Spacelift announced Spacelift Flows, a major Day 2 workflow automation feature, on October 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 5, 2026, Spacelift announced that John Henry Archer joined as SVP of Sales and Channel and Jonah Kowall joined as SVP of Product and Design.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations documentation and current job listings do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system as part of Spacelift's visible stack.
